about.title: Welcome to my site!
about.subtitle: My name is Denys, and I'm ready to help you with any IT-related questions.
about.text: I'm a student at IES Sabadell, working steadily toward my goal of becoming a full-stack developer. My key strengths are persistence and determination. Technology is evolving fast, and competition among developers keeps growing — many give up, but I see nothing but opportunity and a bright future ahead.

resume.name: Denis Peresunko
resume.objective: My current goal is to complement my career and formal IT education with hands-on experience in related fields, broaden my horizons, and keep learning through real work.
